details: This app has crashed because it attempted to access privacy-sensitive data without a usage description. The app's Info.plist must contain an NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription key with a string value explaining to the user how the app uses this data.

installedPurposes.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Sieghart transcribes your spoken focus commands after you start listening.
installedPurposes.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sieghart listens only when you press the voice button.
